inputs.style:
Traditional Thrash Metal, aggressive and raw, heavy distorted guitars, thunderous double-bass drums, punchy low-end bass, powerful male vocals, fast tempo, high energy, no spoken words
Choose the complete song's natural length and structure yourself. There is no required target duration. The safety ceiling is 900 seconds, not a goal to fill. Compose a coherent intro, verses, chorus and resolved final outro with final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words and then end the song naturally. No endless loop or unfinished solo. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Concrete cracks beneath the feet
Shadows stretch across the street
The sirens wail in hollow tune
Beneath the rust and broken moon

[Chorus]
This is our concrete dominion
Where the broken find their prison
Scream until the walls give way
Chase the night until it's day

[Verse]
Steel bars bend but do not break
Every step is for the sake
Of the ones who fell behind
Leaving dust on the blind

[Chorus]
This is our concrete dominion
Where the broken find their prison
Scream until the walls give way
Chase the night until it's day

[Bridge]
Rise up from the ash and bone
Make the silence scream and groan
No mercy in the iron gate
Just the rhythm of the fate

[Chorus]
This is our concrete dominion
Where the broken find their prison
Scream until the walls give way
Chase the night until it's day

[Outro]
Dominion... falls... silent
